articles.title_en: Making ends meet in refugee camps: Food distribution cycles, consumption and undernutrition
articles.title_cn: 在难民营中维持生计：粮食分配周期、消费与营养不足
articles.abstract_en: Years after the initial settlement, food aid remains an essential component of humanitarian assistance for protracted refugees in managed camps. From data collected among refugee households in three camps in southern Chad and an exogenous variation of time between the latest food distribution and households’ interviews, we draw the time path of household’s consumption. Consistent with the literature on intertemporal choices in high-income countries, refugee households experience an average decline of 1.1 to 1.5 percent per day in their daily caloric intake between distributions. The short-term nutritional status of children under five also responds to the distance from food aid distribution and confirms the existence of food distribution cycles. Our results suggest that households don’t smooth consumption during the interval of time between two distributions, and face regular and frequent cycles of food shortage resulting in detrimental consequences on children’s health.
articles.abstract_cn: 在最初安置多年后，粮食援助仍然是管理式难民营中长期难民人道主义援助的重要组成部分。基于在乍得南部三个难民营中收集的难民家庭数据，以及最新粮食分配与家庭访谈之间时间的外生变化，我们描绘了家庭消费的时间路径。与高收入国家跨期选择研究的文献一致，难民家庭在两次分配之间的每日卡路里摄入量平均每天下降1.1至1.5%。五岁以下儿童的短期营养状况也对粮食援助分配的时间间隔作出反应，并证实了粮食分配周期的存在。我们的结果表明，家庭在两次分配之间的时间间隔内并未平滑消费，而是面临定期且频繁的粮食短缺周期，这对儿童健康产生了不利影响。

articles.title_en: How does recall bias in farm labor impact separability tests?
articles.title_cn: 农业劳动力回忆偏差如何影响可分性检验？
articles.abstract_en: In the agricultural household literature, empirical tests of separability between production and consumption decisions commonly exploit theoretical predictions of household labor allocation. Many of these studies rely on data that asks respondents to recall labor usage over the entire growing season. Two recent field experiments in Tanzania and Ghana show that such labor use data, collected at the end of the growing season, is a systematically unreliable measure of actual labor allocation. In this study, we examine how inaccurate measures of labor influence the reliability of market failure tests based on separability. In Ghana, we find no statistical evidence that recall bias influences the reliability of the separability test. In Tanzania, we find that recall bias increases the probability that such tests fail to reject separability. Thus, we find partial evidence that classic tests based on typical household survey labor data may erroneously conclude that markets are adequately functioning.
articles.abstract_cn: 在农业家庭文献中，关于生产与消费决策可分性的实证检验通常利用家庭劳动力配置的理论预测。许多此类研究依赖于要求受访者回忆整个生长季节劳动力使用情况的数据。最近在坦桑尼亚和加纳进行的两项田间实验表明，这种在生长季节结束时收集的劳动力使用数据，是对实际劳动力配置的系统性不可靠度量。在本研究中，我们考察了劳动力测量的不准确性如何影响基于可分性的市场失灵检验的可靠性。在加纳，我们没有发现统计证据表明回忆偏差影响可分性检验的可靠性。在坦桑尼亚，我们发现回忆偏差增加了此类检验未能拒绝可分性的概率。因此，我们发现了部分证据表明，基于典型家庭调查劳动力数据的经典检验可能错误地得出市场功能正常的结论。

articles.title_en: Tax on sugary drinks in Brazil: Simulation of impacts on the purchases of non-alcoholic drinks and family welfare
articles.title_cn: 巴西含糖饮料税：对非酒精饮料购买和家庭福利影响的模拟
articles.abstract_en: The objective of this study is to simulate possible impacts of adopting sugary drinks tax policies on the purchases of non-alcoholic beverages and on Brazilian family welfare, aiming to contribute with empirical evidence for Bill No. 2183, of 2019, pending in the Federal Senate, also known as CIDE-Soft Drinks. To simulate different tax scenarios, price and expenditure elasticities of non-alcoholic beverages were measured using the QUAIDS model with adaptations for zero expenditure and expenditure and price endogeneity problems. Based on the Household Budget Survey data of 2017–2018, three scenarios of fiscal policies were simulated: (1) adoption of a 20% tax on sugary drinks (CIDE-Soft Drinks); (2) adoption of a 20% tax on the price of sugary and sweetened drinks; and (3) a 20% tax on sugary drinks combined with a 41.51% subsidy on water price aiming at a neutral revenue. The results show that scenario 3 would provide greater reductions in the purchase of sugary drinks and stimulate the consumption of water. The effects of this kind of tax are greater for low-income families.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在模拟采用含糖饮料税政策对非酒精饮料购买和巴西家庭福利可能产生的影响，旨在为联邦参议院待审的第2183号法案（2019年），即所谓的CIDE-软饮料，提供实证证据。为模拟不同的税收情景，使用QUAIDS模型并针对零支出以及支出和价格内生性问题进行适应性调整，测量了非酒精饮料的价格和支出弹性。基于2017-2018年家庭预算调查数据，模拟了三种财政政策情景：(1)对含糖饮料征收20%的税（CIDE-软饮料）；(2)对含糖和加糖饮料价格征收20%的税；以及(3)对含糖饮料征收20%的税，同时结合对水价41.51%的补贴，以实现收入中性。结果表明，情景3将更大程度地减少含糖饮料的购买，并刺激水的消费。此类税收对低收入家庭的影响更大。

articles.title_en: Public preferences for meat tax attributes in The Netherlands: A discrete choice experiment
articles.title_cn: 荷兰肉类税属性的公众偏好：一项离散选择实验
articles.abstract_en: To stay within global environmental boundaries, the food system requires significant changes. In this context, a tax on meat products is frequently proposed as a policy measure to stimulate a dietary shift away from meat products. Understanding public preferences for the design of such a tax may serve as a starting point for increasing its political feasibility. Our paper explores public preferences for meat tax attributes among inhabitants of the Netherlands, the most livestock-intensive country in Europe. Using a discrete choice experiment, we estimate relative preferences for the following tax design attributes: (i) use of tax revenues; (ii) products under taxation; and (iii) joint efforts by other countries. Our results indicate that Dutch people significantly prefer a meat tax that exempts poultry or organic products, is implemented in a joint effort with several other EU countries, and earmarks revenues for specific purposes, with the preference for using revenues to reduce the value-added tax on fruits and vegetables being the strongest. We find significant heterogeneity in these preferences, which we explore using a latent class logit model. While the classes do not exhibit highly distinct socio-economic profiles, they are characterized by a combination of factors such as gender, income levels, and education. Our results may inform ongoing discussions about meat taxation in the Netherlands and contribute to further research on meat tax preferences in other countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了保持在全球环境边界内，食品系统需要进行重大变革。在此背景下，对肉类产品征税常被提议作为政策手段，以刺激饮食结构从肉类产品转变。了解公众对此类税收设计的偏好，可作为提高其政治可行性的起点。我们的论文探讨了荷兰居民对肉类税属性的公众偏好，荷兰是欧洲畜牧业最密集的国家。通过离散选择实验，我们估计了以下税收设计属性的相对偏好：（i）税收收入的使用；（ii）征税产品；以及（iii）其他国家的联合行动。我们的结果表明，荷兰人显著偏好豁免家禽或有机产品的肉类税，与多个欧盟国家联合实施，并将收入专款专用，其中将收入用于降低水果和蔬菜增值税的偏好最强。我们发现这些偏好存在显著异质性，我们使用潜在类别logit模型进行了探索。虽然各类别并未展现出高度不同的社会经济特征，但它们以性别、收入水平和教育等因素的组合为特征。我们的结果可能为荷兰肉类税的持续讨论提供信息，并有助于其他国家肉类税偏好的进一步研究。

articles.title_en: Between dissonance and confusion: When the Nutri-Score as a nutritional signal is misinterpreted
articles.title_cn: 在不和谐与困惑之间：当Nutri-Score作为营养信号被误解时
articles.abstract_en: The introduction of a mandatory front-of-package nutrition label across the European Union is generating fierce controversy. Specifically, the Nutri-Score has been under debate, which has been reflected in the media. Drawing on signaling theory, this article aims to investigate how some consumers make sense of the Nutri-Score as a signal of nutritional quality in this noisy environment. First, a study analyzes how the media communicates about the Nutri-Score. Second, 15 semi-structured interviews examine how women with children interpret and use the Nutri-Score. Our findings show that media coverage of the Nutri-Score becomes ambiguous over time and that these women experience confusion due to cognitive dissonance and lack of knowledge. This article contributes to the literature on nutrition labeling and highlights the risks of confusion in interpreting this signal of nutritional quality. It suggests implications for policymakers and economic actors to promote the use of the Nutri-Score while reducing information asymmetry.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟范围内强制实施包装正面营养标签的引入引发了激烈争议。具体而言，Nutri-Score一直处于争论之中，这一点在媒体上有所反映。借鉴信号理论，本文旨在探讨在这一嘈杂环境中，一些消费者如何理解Nutri-Score作为营养质量信号的。首先，一项研究分析了媒体如何传播关于Nutri-Score的信息。其次，15次半结构化访谈考察了有子女的女性如何解读和使用Nutri-Score。我们的研究结果表明，媒体对Nutri-Score的报道随时间变得模糊，这些女性因认知失调和知识缺乏而经历困惑。本文对营养标签文献有所贡献，并强调了在解读这一营养质量信号时产生混淆的风险。它为政策制定者和经济行为者提供了促进Nutri-Score使用同时减少信息不对称的启示。

articles.title_en: Assessing misallocation in agriculture: Plots versus farms
articles.title_cn: 评估农业中的错配：地块与农场
articles.abstract_en: We examine empirically whether the level of data aggregation affects the assessment of misallocation in agriculture. Using data from Ugandan farmers, we document a substantial discrepancy between misallocation measures calculated at the plot and at the farm levels. Estimates of misallocation at the plot level are much higher than those obtained with the same data but aggregated at the farm level. Even after accounting for measurement error and unobserved heterogeneity, estimates of misallocation at the plot level are extremely high, with potential nationwide agricultural productivity gains of 562%. Furthermore, we find suggestive evidence that granular data may be more susceptible to measurement error in survey data and that data aggregation can attenuate the relative magnitude of measurement error in misallocation measures. Our findings suggest caution in generalizing insights on measurement error and misallocation from plot-level analysis to those at the farm level.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们实证考察了数据聚合水平是否影响对农业中错配的评估。利用乌干达农民的数据，我们记录了在地块层面和农场层面计算的错配指标之间存在显著差异。地块层面的错配估计远高于使用相同数据但聚合到农场层面所得到的估计。即使在考虑了测量误差和未观测异质性之后，地块层面的错配估计仍然极高，潜在的全国农业生产力提升可达562%。此外，我们发现有提示性证据表明，在调查数据中，更细粒度的数据可能更容易受到测量误差的影响，而数据聚合可以减弱测量误差在错配指标中的相对大小。我们的研究结果表明，在将关于测量误差和错配的见解从地块层面分析推广到农场层面时需谨慎。

articles.title_en: Women’s empowerment and intra-household diet diversity across the urban continuum: Evidence from India’s DHS
articles.title_cn: 女性赋权与城市连续体中的家庭内膳食多样性：来自印度DHS的证据
articles.abstract_en: Women’s empowerment has been associated with improved nutritional outcomes in various settings. However, the gains from empowerment do not necessarily accrue to different members of the same household in the same manner. Furthermore, the relationship between empowerment and nutrition itself is likely to be shaped by the overall level of development in a given region. This paper investigates the heterogeneity in the association between women’s empowerment in nutrition index (WENI) and quality of intra-household diets between men and women when spatial variations in the levels of urbanization are accounted for, in India. We use intrahousehold dietary intake data for 60,000 men and women from the fourth round of India’s National Family Health Survey and conceptualize women’s empowerment using the women’s empowerment in nutrition index (WENI). We use geospatial data on nightlights as a proxy for the urban continuum. Nightlights intensity (NTL) captures the growth of smaller towns (between large urban cities and rural areas) that has characterized urbanization in India. A multilevel modeling approach indicates that a unit increase in WENI scores is associated with an improvement in women’s diet diversity scores by 0.19 units, with no significant association for men’s diet diversity. Heterogeneity analysis indicates that this finding holds at all NTL terciles. Alongside the role of WENI, we find that a doubling of NTL is associated with an increase in diet diversity scores by atleast 7–8% for both men and women, across wealth quintiles. These results emphasize the need for targeted approaches based on spatial heterogeneity in growth and development within a country when investing in the empowerment-nutrition pathway.
articles.abstract_cn: 女性赋权已在不同背景下与改善的营养结果相关联。然而，赋权带来的收益并不一定以相同方式惠及同一家庭的不同成员。此外，赋权与营养之间的关系本身可能受到特定地区整体发展水平的影响。本文研究了在考虑城市化水平空间差异的情况下，印度女性赋权营养指数（WENI）与家庭内男女膳食质量之间关联的异质性。我们使用来自印度第四轮全国家庭健康调查的60,000名男性和女性的家庭内膳食摄入数据，并使用女性赋权营养指数（WENI）来概念化女性赋权。我们使用夜间灯光地理空间数据作为城市连续体的代理。夜间灯光强度（NTL）捕捉了印度城市化特征中较小城镇（介于大城市和农村地区之间）的增长。多层次建模方法表明，WENI评分每增加一个单位，女性膳食多样性评分提高0.19个单位，而男性膳食多样性无显著关联。异质性分析表明，这一发现在所有NTL三分位组中均成立。除了WENI的作用外，我们发现NTL翻倍与男性和女性膳食多样性评分增加至少7-8%相关，且这一关联在各财富五分位组中均存在。这些结果强调了在投资于赋权-营养路径时，基于国家内部增长与发展的空间异质性采取针对性方法的必要性。

articles.title_en: Revisiting heterogenous social desirability bias in consumer willingness to pay for food carbon label: Social norms and environmental concerns
articles.title_cn: 重新审视消费者对食品碳标签支付意愿中的异质性社会期望偏差：社会规范与环境关注
articles.abstract_en: Carbon labeling facilitates the evaluation of carbon emissions throughout the entire food production process. Consumer interpretation of food labels is subject to context. We conduct an online discrete choice experiment in four Chinese cities to investigate the potential how social desirability bias (SDB) may affect consumer willingness-to-pay (WTP) for milk carbon labels. Our findings indicate that failing to account for SDB leads to skewed WTP estimates. We observe a significant presence of SDB in WTP for carbon labels, particularly among respondents under subject to injunctive social-norm treatment. Additionally, our research shows that SDB can manifest differently among consumers with varying levels of environmental commitment. This research provides crucial insights for both policymakers and marketers in food carbon labeling. It highlights the importance of considering SDB and emphasizes the necessity of developing tailored strategies across different consumer segments.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳标签有助于评估整个食品生产过程中的碳排放。消费者对食品标签的理解受情境影响。我们在中国四个城市进行了一项在线离散选择实验，以调查社会期望偏差（SDB）可能如何影响消费者对牛奶碳标签的支付意愿（WTP）。我们的研究结果表明，未能考虑SDB会导致WTP估计出现偏差。我们观察到碳标签WTP中存在显著的SDB，尤其是在受到指令性社会规范处理的受访者中。此外，我们的研究显示，SDB在环境承诺水平不同的消费者中可能表现不同。这项研究为食品碳标签的政策制定者和营销人员提供了重要见解。它强调了考虑SDB的重要性，并强调了针对不同消费者群体制定定制策略的必要性。

articles.title_en: Policy options for managing avian influenza in dairy cows
articles.title_cn: 奶牛禽流感管理的政策选择
articles.abstract_en: •Proposes coordinated federal and state responses to avian influenza in dairy cows.•Highlights critical biosecurity measures to prevent avian influenza outbreaks.•Recommends improved surveillance systems for rapid detection and response.•Emphasizes investment in vaccine development and genetic resistance breeding.•Addresses economic and public health impacts of avian influenza on the dairy sector.
articles.abstract_cn: •提出联邦和州协调应对奶牛禽流感的措施。•强调关键的生物安全措施，以防止禽流感爆发。•建议改进监测系统，以便快速检测和响应。•强调投资于疫苗开发和遗传抗性育种。•解决禽流感对奶牛部门的经济和公共卫生影响。

articles.title_en: Food politics in China: How strengthened accountability enhances food security
articles.title_cn: 中国的粮食政治：强化问责如何提升粮食安全
articles.abstract_en: As the locus of political power, state is widely acknowledged to play an important role in achieving Sustainable Development Goals, particularly in food security. However, the means through which states can harness their power to enhance food security, particularly in developing countries, has yet to be thoroughly explored. This paper addresses this gap by examining the effects of enhanced accountability on food security, and investigating how it can operationalize food security goals into enforceable directives for lower-tier officials, with a focus on China. Utilizing the implementation of the “provincial governor responsibility system for farmland protection and grain production” as a natural experiment and employing a difference-in-difference strategy, we demonstrate that main grain-producing areas (MGPAs), whose governors’ promotion is more tightly linked to food producing, experience a more significant increase in grain sowing areas when compared to other provinces. The results are robust facing a series of robustness checks. Additionally, by considering the dispatch of central inspection team, political cycle, and governor’s tenure as the sources of variations in accountability, we confirm that the key mechanism at play is the accountability inherent in China’s nomenklatura system, rather than alternative economic incentives. The back-of-the-envelope calculation demonstrates the increased grain production caused by strengthened accountability could meet the basic food needs of at least 8.76 million people annually. Our findings highlight that crafting tailored policies based on different political systems to strengthen official accountability is of great significance for better governance of food security.
articles.abstract_cn: 作为政治权力的核心，国家被广泛认为在实现可持续发展目标，特别是粮食安全方面发挥着重要作用。然而，国家如何利用其权力来增强粮食安全，尤其是在发展中国家，尚未得到充分探讨。本文通过考察强化问责对粮食安全的影响，并研究其如何将粮食安全目标转化为对下级官员的可执行指令，以中国为焦点，填补了这一空白。利用“省级政府耕地保护和粮食生产责任制”的实施作为自然实验，并采用双重差分策略，我们证明，与其他省份相比，主产粮区（MGPAs）的粮食播种面积增长更为显著，因为这些地区省长的晋升与粮食生产联系更为紧密。这一结果在一系列稳健性检验中依然成立。此外，通过考虑中央巡视组的派遣、政治周期和省长任期作为问责差异的来源，我们确认关键机制在于中国干部管理制度中固有的问责，而非其他经济激励。粗略计算表明，强化问责带来的粮食增产每年至少可满足8.76百万人的基本粮食需求。我们的研究结果强调，基于不同政治制度制定针对性政策以强化官员问责，对于更好地治理粮食安全具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Development of the Food Systems Literacy Competencies Framework for youth: A modified Delphi study with experts
articles.title_cn: 青年食物系统素养能力框架的开发：一项专家改良德尔菲研究
articles.abstract_en: Food systems have changed drastically in the last 50 years, are continuously globalizing, and are constantly responding to environmental, social, economic and political challenges. While a primary goal of food systems is to provide food security, food insecurity rates have continued to rise in recent years. To deal with these systemic problems, food systems experts call for food systems literacy. However, there are no common frameworks outlining what people should know about food systems, making it challenging to relay information into education and to the general population. As such, the aim of this research was to identify competencies for food systems literacy for youth in Canada. We conducted a 2-round modified Delphi study to achieve consensus on a list of key competencies for food systems literacy. Delphi studies allow for broad consultation of expert judgements to achieve consensus on complex issues. This resulted in a list of 50 key competencies for food systems literacy (out of 131 tested) across themes for Indigenous food systems, food systems activities (i.e., production to waste as well as some overarching and technology themes), sustainability, food security and governance. This Framework of competencies is the first of its kind and will be useful for directing how food systems can be integrated into education as well as be a guide for food systems literacy evaluation tools.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去50年中，食物系统发生了巨大变化，持续全球化，并不断应对环境、社会、经济和政治挑战。虽然食物系统的主要目标是提供粮食安全，但近年来粮食不安全率持续上升。为了应对这些系统性问题，食物系统专家呼吁提高食物系统素养。然而，目前尚无共同框架概述人们应了解食物系统的哪些内容，这使得将信息传递到教育领域和普通公众面临挑战。因此，本研究旨在确定加拿大青年食物系统素养的能力。我们进行了一项2轮改良德尔菲研究，以就食物系统素养的关键能力清单达成共识。德尔菲研究允许广泛咨询专家判断，以就复杂问题达成共识。最终形成了50项食物系统素养关键能力（从131项测试中选出），涵盖原住民食物系统、食物系统活动（即从生产到废物处理以及一些总体和技术主题）、可持续性、粮食安全和治理等主题。该能力框架是首个此类框架，将有助于指导如何将食物系统纳入教育，并可作为食物系统素养评估工具的指南。

articles.title_en: Temperature and children’s dietary diversity: Evidence from India
articles.title_cn: 温度与儿童膳食多样性：来自印度的证据
articles.abstract_en: Children’s exposure to heat is related to both chronic and acute nutritional status. However, there is limited empirical evidence on how a rise in temperature affects dietary quality. Using the most recent rounds of the Demographic Health Survey for India, conducted in 2015–16 and 2019–20, combined with geospatial data from various sources, this study empirically explores the relationship between temperature and dietary diversity of children in the age group of 6 to 23 months. The study highlights that higher temperatures are associated with a modest yet statistically significant decrease in the dietary diversity of children aged 6 to 23 months. We also find that, while minor temperature variations may have minimal effects, larger shifts within specific temperature ranges can lead to more pronounced alterations in children’s dietary diversity. Moreover, factors such as children’s age, historical climate context, and seasonality influence the magnitude of this relationship. Additionally, access to infrastructure and maternal education significantly mediate the adverse effects of temperature on children’s dietary patterns, highlighting the importance of targeted interventions in vulnerable communities..
articles.abstract_cn: 儿童暴露于高温与慢性和急性营养状况均有关。然而，关于气温上升如何影响膳食质量的实证证据有限。利用印度人口健康调查最近几轮数据（分别于2015-16年和2019-20年进行），结合来自不同来源的地理空间数据，本研究实证探讨了温度与6至23个月龄儿童膳食多样性之间的关系。研究强调，较高温度与6至23个月龄儿童膳食多样性的适度但统计显著的下降相关。我们还发现，虽然轻微的温度变化可能影响甚微，但特定温度范围内较大的变化可能导致儿童膳食多样性更显著的变化。此外，儿童年龄、历史气候背景和季节性等因素影响这种关系的强度。另外，基础设施的可及性和母亲教育显著调节了温度对儿童膳食模式的不利影响，凸显了在脆弱社区进行有针对性的干预的重要性。

articles.title_en: Market food environments and child nutrition
articles.title_cn: 市场食品环境与儿童营养
articles.abstract_en: Child malnutrition remains a widespread public health problem in sub-Saharan Africa. Providing access to nutritious foods for all is key, but it is not clear how this can be achieved in various local contexts. Here, we analyze the role of markets and food environments for child diets and nutrition in Malawi along a rural-urban continuum. We develop a new methodology to characterize food environments in terms of the variety of fresh and processed foods available in local market settings. Geocoded data of market food variety are combined with individual-level child diet and anthropometric data collected through a household survey. We find large differences in food environments, diets, and nutrition outcomes between urban, rural, and remote locations. The spatially-explicit analysis shows that market food variety is positively associated with dietary diversity and negatively associated with stunting, also after controlling for confounding factors. Strikingly, processed food variety has more favorable associations with child nutrition than fresh food variety, suggesting that lightly and moderately processed foods are important sources of nutrients in the local settings. Our findings stress the importance of improving the functioning of markets for nutritious foods, especially in rural areas. Conceptually, we add to the literature on measuring food environments.
articles.abstract_cn: 儿童营养不良仍然是撒哈拉以南非洲地区普遍存在的公共卫生问题。为所有人提供营养食品的获取是关键，但在不同的地方背景下如何实现这一点尚不明确。在此，我们分析了马拉维沿城乡连续体的市场与食品环境对儿童饮食和营养的作用。我们开发了一种新方法，用以表征当地市场环境中新鲜和加工食品多样性的食品环境。将市场食品多样性的地理编码数据与通过家庭调查收集的个体儿童饮食和人体测量数据相结合。我们发现城市、农村和偏远地区之间的食品环境、饮食和营养结果存在巨大差异。空间显式分析表明，市场食品多样性与饮食多样性正相关，与发育迟缓负相关，即使在控制混杂因素后也是如此。引人注目的是，加工食品多样性与儿童营养的关联比新鲜食品多样性更有利，这表明轻度及中度加工食品在当地环境中是重要的营养来源。我们的发现强调了改善营养食品市场功能的重要性，尤其是在农村地区。在概念上，我们为测量食品环境的文献做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Impact of food hubs on food security and sustainability: Food hubs perspectives from Leeds, UK
articles.title_cn: 食品枢纽对粮食安全和可持续性的影响：来自英国利兹的食品枢纽视角
articles.abstract_en: In the context of rising food insecurity, food hubs such as food pantries, food banks, community agriculture supported schemes, social supermarkets, community kitchens and cafes, have proliferated both in number and in the roles they perform. Food hubs have a range of benefits in the communities that they serve as well as the wider food system. However, more empirical evidence is required to build a compelling case for policy support. Using the area of Leeds, UK as a case study, and taking a mixed methods approach (i.e. evidence synthesis, mapping, survey and interviews) we present the food hubs’ perspectives on the benefits that they offer to food security, sustainability, resilience and food justice. Food hubs reflect on how their activities enhance sustainability, strengthen local food systems, support local economies, and improve the health, wellbeing and agency of their communities. In doing so, food hubs contribute to regional, national and global priorities on food security, health, sustainability, justice and resilience. However, to scale up or out their positive impact, food hubs require support to transition away from emergency food provision to longer-term, holistic and financially viable models that focus on community wellbeing and empowerment, healthy diets, local economies and environmental sustainability.
articles.abstract_cn: 在粮食不安全日益加剧的背景下，食品枢纽（如食品储藏室、食品银行、社区支持农业计划、社会超市、社区厨房和咖啡馆）在数量和所扮演的角色上均有所增加。食品枢纽为其服务的社区以及更广泛的食品系统带来了一系列益处。然而，需要更多的实证证据来为政策支持提供有力依据。以英国利兹地区为案例研究，采用混合方法（即证据综合、绘图、调查和访谈），我们呈现了食品枢纽对其在粮食安全、可持续性、韧性和食品正义方面所提供益处的看法。食品枢纽反思了其活动如何增强可持续性、加强本地食品系统、支持本地经济，并改善其社区的健康、福祉和自主权。通过这样做，食品枢纽为区域、国家和全球在粮食安全、健康、可持续性、正义和韧性方面的优先事项做出了贡献。然而，为了扩大其积极影响，食品枢纽需要支持，以从紧急食品供应过渡到长期、整体且财务可行的模式，这些模式侧重于社区福祉和赋权、健康饮食、本地经济和环境可持续性。

articles.title_en: The impact of pre-empting dual food quality regulation on product reformulation and packaging
articles.title_cn: 预先制定双重食品质量法规对产品配方调整和包装的影响
articles.abstract_en: The objective of this paper is to analyse the changes in the occurrence of the Differences in Composition of Seemingly Identical, branded food Products (DC-SIP) – also known as “dual food quality” – in the EU and the role of the Unfair Commercial Practices Directive (UCPD) in affecting the food industry’s packaging and recipe formulation choices of branded food products. The occurrence of DC-SIP has decreased from 31 % in 2018/2019 to 24 % in 2021. Our regression results show that companies are more likely to alter the front packaging rather than the composition of the products to address DC-SIP issues. The likelihood that changes in recipe reformulations and front packaging are introduced simultaneously is statistically significant but not all recipe reformulations are introduced jointly with changes in front packaging. Our results provide evidence that the UCPD regulation plays a role in companies reformulating recipes or/and changing the product packaging, but it is not a main driver. Companies often justify the composition differences in DC-SIP by differences in market conditions across Member States. The DC-SIP provisions in the UCPD give companies several options for addressing DC-SIP. For this reason, it is not a significant factor in impacting the companies' choices to reformulate or change the packaging of products.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在分析欧盟内部看似相同品牌食品产品成分差异（DC-SIP）——也称为“双重食品质量”——发生的变化，以及《不公平商业行为指令》（UCPD）在影响食品行业品牌食品产品包装和配方选择方面的作用。DC-SIP的发生率已从2018/2019年的31%下降至2021年的24%。我们的回归结果表明，公司更倾向于改变产品的前包装而非产品成分来解决DC-SIP问题。配方调整和前包装变更同时引入的可能性在统计上显著，但并非所有配方调整都与前包装变更同时进行。我们的结果证明，UCPD法规在公司调整配方或/和改变产品包装方面发挥了一定作用，但并非主要驱动因素。公司通常将DC-SIP中的成分差异归因于各成员国市场条件的差异。UCPD中的DC-SIP条款为公司解决DC-SIP提供了多种选择。因此，它并不是影响公司选择调整配方或改变产品包装的重要因素。

articles.title_en: Reflections on food policy in the context of healthy and sustainable diets
articles.title_cn: 健康与可持续饮食背景下的食品政策反思
articles.abstract_en: Governments are urged to make significant changes to food policies to reorient food production and consumption to support healthy and sustainable food systems and diets. New Zealand, like many countries, is under pressure to address the deleterious effects of its food system on food security, nutrition, and environmental health to meet global sustainable development goals. We completed a systematic policy review to assess how food policies in New Zealand support the transition to sustainable diets by aligning with sustainable diet principles and whether this is enabled through multisectoral collaboration and policy coherence. We analysed New Zealand’s food policies against a sustainable diet framework, examining if policies are aligned with all dimensions: health and nutrition, environmental, sociocultural, and economic. We found that while sustainability is a priority, the economic, environmental, and sociocultural outcomes dominate policies concerned with food production and trade, with little attention given to nutritional health. We also found that the health impacts are often left out of multisectoral collaboration efforts and that there is a lack of coherence between health, food production, and trade sector policies concerning nutrition. These findings suggest that current policies will likely undermine nutrition-related health goals and hinder New Zealand’s ability to shift to sustainable diets and food systems. Further research is required to understand how food policies influence food producer and consumer behaviours and determine how a more coherent and comprehensive sustainability-oriented policy environment shifts behaviours towards more sustainable diets and food systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府被敦促对食品政策进行重大调整，以重新引导食品生产和消费，支持健康和可持续的食品系统与饮食。新西兰与许多国家一样，面临压力，需要解决其食品系统对粮食安全、营养和环境健康的不利影响，以实现全球可持续发展目标。我们进行了一项系统的政策审查，以评估新西兰的食品政策如何通过符合可持续饮食原则来支持向可持续饮食的过渡，以及这是否通过多部门合作和政策一致性得以实现。我们对照可持续饮食框架分析了新西兰的食品政策，检查政策是否与所有维度一致：健康与营养、环境、社会文化和经济。我们发现，虽然可持续性是一个优先事项，但经济、环境和社会文化成果主导了涉及食品生产和贸易的政策，而对营养健康的关注很少。我们还发现，健康影响往往被排除在多部门合作努力之外，并且健康、食品生产和贸易部门政策在营养方面缺乏一致性。这些发现表明，当前政策可能会削弱与营养相关的健康目标，并阻碍新西兰向可持续饮食和食品系统转变的能力。需要进一步研究以了解食品政策如何影响食品生产者和消费者的行为，并确定一个更一致和全面的以可持续性为导向的政策环境如何将行为转向更可持续的饮食和食品系统。

articles.title_en: Impact of crop commercialization on smallholder farmers’ resilience to shocks: Evidence from panel data for rural Southeast Asia
articles.title_cn: 作物商业化对小农户冲击韧性的影响：来自东南亚农村面板数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: We assess the impact of crop commercialization on the resilience to shocks of smallholder farmers and examine which groups of smallholders are more resilient from crop commercialization. We use balanced panel of 1,370 smallholders from Thailand and 1,497 smallholders from Vietnam collected in three survey waves for the empirical analysis. We employ a generalized structural equation model to estimate the (latent) variable of smallholders’ resilience. Then, we apply fixed-effects estimations with an instrumental variable and a control function approach to address the endogeneity concerns of crop commercialization in assessing the impact of commercialization on the resilience of smallholders. The results show that crop commercialization has a positive effect on smallholders’ resilience capacity. To examine which groups of smallholders are more resilient from crop commercialization, we apply an unconditional quantile regression model. The results show that crop commercialization has the highest impact on smallholders in 10th and 25th quantile groups of resilience capacity. Thus, crop commercialization should be stimulated to improve smallholders’ resilience to shocks. Besides, improving infrastructure for transportation and information and communication technology at the village level and the effectiveness of public governance at the national level could lead to a better resilience of smallholders.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估了作物商业化对小农户冲击韧性的影响，并考察了哪些小农户群体更能从作物商业化中获益。我们使用来自泰国1,370个小农户和越南1,497个小农户的平衡面板数据，这些数据通过三轮调查收集，用于实证分析。我们采用广义结构方程模型来估计小农户韧性的（潜在）变量。然后，我们应用带有工具变量的固定效应估计和控制函数方法，以解决作物商业化在评估其对小农户韧性影响时的内生性问题。结果表明，作物商业化对小农户的韧性能力有正向影响。为了考察哪些小农户群体更能从作物商业化中获益，我们应用了无条件分位数回归模型。结果显示，作物商业化对韧性能力处于10和25分位数的小农户影响最大。因此，应鼓励作物商业化以提高小农户对冲击的韧性。此外，改善村级交通和信息通信技术基础设施以及国家级公共治理的有效性，可以带来更好的小农户韧性。

articles.title_en: Integrating system dynamics to value chain analysis to address price volatility in the Indonesian chilli value chain
articles.title_cn: 整合系统动力学与价值链分析以应对印尼辣椒价值链中的价格波动
articles.abstract_en: The price volatility observed in agricultural value chains presents a significant socio-economic challenge, particularly for smallholder farmers. The issue of price volatility in agricultural value chains is complex due to the dynamic and interconnected nature of these value chains. The objective of this study is to integrate system dynamics with value chain analysis in order to address price volatility in the Indonesian chilli value chain. In order to ensure stakeholder engagement and enhance the robustness of the proposed solutions, a participatory approach will be employed. The utilisation of system dynamics enables the quantitative simulation of the inherent dynamics of the chilli value chain, thereby facilitating both ex-ante and ex-post assessment of policy interventions. A collaborative process with stakeholders was employed to develop, test, and validate a system dynamics model that operates at both provincial and national levels. The findings demonstrate that the model accurately replicates the price volatility observed in the Indonesian chilli market. The key factors contributing to this volatility are seasonal production, disorganised market governance and high postharvest losses. The analysis of policy options indicates that while the importation of chillies can stabilise prices in the short term, it has a negative impact on the income of those involved in the value chain. More sustainable solutions to mitigate price volatility include the implementation of year-round planting and the enhancement of market governance. These strategies present potential avenues for achieving a more stable and equitable chilli market, offering valuable insights for broader agricultural value chain stability.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业价值链中观察到的价格波动带来了重大的社会经济挑战，尤其是对小农户而言。由于农业价值链的动态性和相互关联性，价格波动问题十分复杂。本研究的目标是将系统动力学与价值链分析相结合，以应对印尼辣椒价值链中的价格波动。为了确保利益相关者的参与并增强所提解决方案的稳健性，将采用参与式方法。系统动力学的利用能够对辣椒价值链的内在动态进行定量模拟，从而促进政策干预的事前和事后评估。与利益相关者合作开发、测试和验证了一个在省级和国家级层面运作的系统动力学模型。研究结果表明，该模型准确复制了印尼辣椒市场中观察到的价格波动。导致这种波动的主要因素是季节性生产、无序的市场治理和高产后损失。政策选项分析表明，虽然进口辣椒可以在短期内稳定价格，但对价值链参与者的收入产生负面影响。缓解价格波动的更可持续解决方案包括实施全年种植和加强市场治理。这些策略为实现更稳定和公平的辣椒市场提供了潜在途径，为更广泛的农业价值链稳定性提供了宝贵见解。

articles.title_en: Women improving nutrition through self-help groups in India: Does nutrition information help?
articles.title_cn: 印度妇女通过自助小组改善营养：营养信息是否有帮助？
articles.abstract_en: Women’s self-help groups (SHGs) are an important platform for reaching poor women in India. Despite SHGs' women-focused programming, evidence of the impact of SHG-based interventions on nutrition outcomes is limited, and most evaluations of nutrition interventions have not examined intermediate outcomes along the impact pathways or outcomes for women themselves. This paper evaluates the effectiveness of an integrated agriculture-nutrition intervention delivered through women’s SHGs in five states in central and eastern India. The interventions involved the delivery of nutrition behavior change communication to groups through participatory approaches, community engagement around key issues, and the strengthening of collective organizations. Our analysis is based on three rounds of rich panel data on close to 2700 rural women and their households from eight districts in these five states and qualitative work from an accompanying process evaluation. Using difference-in-difference models with nearest neighbor matching methods, we present results on women’s anthropometry and diet-related outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 妇女自助小组（SHGs）是印度接触贫困妇女的重要平台。尽管自助小组以妇女为重点的项目设计，但基于自助小组的干预措施对营养结果影响的证据有限，且大多数营养干预评估未考察影响路径上的中间结果或妇女自身的结果。本文评估了通过印度中部和东部五个邦的妇女自助小组实施的农业-营养综合干预的有效性。干预措施包括通过参与式方法向小组提供营养行为改变沟通、围绕关键问题的社区参与以及加强集体组织。我们的分析基于这五个邦八个地区近2700名农村妇女及其家庭的三轮丰富面板数据，以及伴随的过程评估中的定性工作。使用双重差分模型结合最近邻匹配方法，我们展示了妇女人体测量和饮食相关结果的结果。

articles.title_en: Autopsy of a futures market failure: Japan’s Dojima rice futures in the early 21st century
articles.title_cn: 期货市场失败的剖析：21世纪初日本的堂岛大米期货
articles.abstract_en: Futures markets promise improved price transparency and risk mitigation for staple commodities important to many developing countries, but they can fail even in developed economies with modern financial institutions. We investigate rice futures trading in Japan at the Osaka Dojima Exchange to identify the reasons underlying its failure in 2021. Our analysis reviews the multiple necessary conditions for a successful commodity futures market. We find the Japanese rice market did not meet many of these conditions. The spot market was fragmented with heterogeneous goods and a single dominant firm. Futures trading was unable to facilitate price discovery or effective hedging activity. To the extent it was traded, the Dojima rice futures contract was instead used as a forward contract for making and taking physical delivery. In addition, there was political opposition and regulatory uncertainty around futures trading. Using detailed data on trader positions in the futures market, we show how these factors contributed to diminished interest in futures trading from firms who handle physical commodities. The lessons from the Japanese case are useful for traders, exchanges, and policy makers, especially those in countries where futures markets may face similarly unfavorable economic and political conditions.
articles.abstract_cn: 期货市场承诺为许多发展中国家重要的主食商品提高价格透明度和风险缓解，但即使在拥有现代金融机构的发达经济体中，它们也可能失败。我们调查了日本大阪堂岛交易所的大米期货交易，以确定其在2021年失败的原因。我们的分析回顾了成功商品期货市场的多个必要条件。我们发现日本大米市场并未满足许多这些条件。现货市场是分散的，商品异质且存在单一主导企业。期货交易无法促进价格发现或有效的对冲活动。就其交易而言，堂岛大米期货合约反而被用作进行实物交割和接收的远期合约。此外，期货交易面临政治反对和监管不确定性。利用期货市场交易者头寸的详细数据，我们展示了这些因素如何导致处理实物商品的公司对期货交易兴趣减弱。日本案例的教训对交易者、交易所和政策制定者，尤其是那些期货市场可能面临类似不利经济和政治条件的国家，具有参考价值。

articles.title_en: Balancing environmental policies and food security goals in the face of shifting U.S. rail transportation regulations
articles.title_cn: 在变化的美国铁路运输法规下平衡环境政策与粮食安全目标
articles.abstract_en: •Analyzes impacts of California’s locomotive regulation on U.S. agricultural logistics.•Explores phased regulation to mitigate disruptions in food security and rural economies.•Discusses legal precedents, including recent U.S. Supreme Court rulings.•Considers economic impacts on agricultural producers with limited transportation options.•Emphasizes the need to balance environmental policies with global food security goals.
articles.abstract_cn: •分析加州机车法规对美国农业物流的影响。•探讨分阶段监管以缓解粮食安全和农村经济的中断。•讨论法律先例，包括美国最高法院最近的裁决。•考虑对运输选择有限的农业生产者的经济影响。•强调平衡环境政策与全球粮食安全目标的必要性。

articles.title_en: Behavioural insights to reach European Union consumer food waste reduction targets
articles.title_cn: 行为洞察以实现欧盟消费者食物浪费减少目标
articles.abstract_en: The European Union is committed via legally binding targets to reduce per capita food waste at the retail and consumption stage. This requires realising profound behavioural change in diverse political and cultural contexts. Work of food waste experts systematically analysing implemented reduction interventions revealed important insights and gaps that need to be jointly addressed by scientists, policymakers and practitioners.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟通过具有法律约束力的目标承诺减少零售和消费阶段的人均食物浪费。这需要在不同的政治和文化背景下实现深刻的行为改变。食物浪费专家系统分析已实施的减少干预措施的工作揭示了重要的见解和差距，这些需要科学家、政策制定者和实践者共同解决。

articles.title_en: Beyond information: The power of personalized nudges in promoting vegetable purchases
articles.title_cn: 超越信息：个性化助推在促进蔬菜购买中的力量
articles.abstract_en: This study explores the impact of providing general health-related information and personalized nudges aimed at modifying cognitive biases on enhancing vegetable purchases and consumption. We conducted a four-month natural field experiment and analyzed daily purchase records of 942 households using receipt scanner data. While merely explaining the loss-framed health benefits of vegetables did not significantly alter the overall vegetable purchasing habits, we observed a notable decrease in meat purchases, attributing this to the indirect effects of vegetable information. Additionally, when the status of relative vegetable purchases amount was provided based on personal purchase histories, individuals who initially purchased more vegetables demonstrated an increased buying volume. This effect was more pronounced in households with children than in those without. The nudging interventions had long-term effects beyond the experiment’s duration, possibly driven by an altruistic concern for children’s health within the household. Therefore, while nudges alone are not a complete solution, their ability to effect long-term changes in household purchasing patterns suggests that they can be a valuable addition to policy tools promoting sustainable and healthy food choices, as well as traditional mass-targeted promotion strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了提供一般健康相关信息以及旨在修正认知偏差的个性化助推对增强蔬菜购买和消费的影响。我们进行了一项为期四个月的自然实地实验，并使用收据扫描仪数据分析了942户家庭的每日购买记录。虽然仅仅解释蔬菜的损失框架健康益处并未显著改变整体的蔬菜购买习惯，但我们观察到肉类购买量显著减少，这归因于蔬菜信息的间接效应。此外，当根据个人购买历史提供相对蔬菜购买量的状态时，最初购买蔬菜较多的个体表现出购买量的增加。这种效应在有孩子的家庭中比没有孩子的家庭更为明显。助推干预在实验结束后具有长期效应，这可能是由家庭中对孩子健康的利他关切所驱动的。因此，虽然助推本身并非完整的解决方案，但它们改变家庭购买模式的长期能力表明，它们可以成为促进可持续和健康食品选择以及传统大众定向推广策略的政策工具的有价值补充。

articles.title_en: A comment on USDA Food Business Centers: Collaborations to nurture innovation in the food system
articles.title_cn: 对美国农业部食品商业中心的评论：合作培育食品系统创新

articles.title_en: An approach for assessing whether agricultural projects help smallholders transition to better livelihood strategies: A malawian case study
articles.title_cn: 评估农业项目是否帮助小农户向更好的生计策略转变的方法：马拉维案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Agricultural projects typically aim to promote the uptake of project components amongst targeted small farm populations to improve their farm productivity and welfare. While this approach can be an important first step towards improving smallholder livelihoods, it ignores alternative and often superior livelihood options that might arise within the rural transformation process, particularly in commercial agriculture and the rural nonfarm economy. We argue that the design of smallholder projects implemented within regions already undergoing a dynamic transformation and/or projects which have significant value chain components, should be broadened to assist smallholders in making successful transitions to their best livelihood options. For such projects, monitoring and evaluation activities should track livelihood transitions as well as the usual assessments of productivity and welfare outcomes. To help operationalize such an approach, we propose a typology of smallholder livelihood strategies that can track transitions over time and illustrate its use with data from the Sustainable Agricultural Production Program (SAPP), an agricultural value chain project in Malawi. Using available household panel data and quasi-experimental econometric approaches, we find that the project helped smallholders transition out of subsistence farming to market-oriented farming and helped already existing market-oriented farmers remain as such. Even though the project did not have any specific components designed to promote off-farm incomes, nevertheless, it facilitated many farm household transitions to off-farm diversified livelihoods, possibly due to spillover benefits generated within the local nonfarm economy. All SAPP facilitated transitions led to increases in household incomes. We conclude with some lessons for designing, monitoring, and the evaluation of future agricultural projects.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业项目通常旨在促进目标小农群体采纳项目组成部分，以提高其农业生产力和福利。虽然这种方法可以是改善小农生计的重要第一步，但它忽视了在农村转型过程中可能出现的替代性且往往更优越的生计选择，特别是在商业农业和农村非农经济中。我们认为，在已经经历动态转型的地区实施的小农项目，以及/或具有显著价值链组成部分的项目，其设计应扩大范围，以帮助小农成功过渡到其最佳生计选择。对于此类项目，监测和评估活动应跟踪生计转变，以及通常的生产力和福利结果评估。为了帮助实施这种方法，我们提出了一种小农生计策略的类型学，可以随时间跟踪转变，并利用马拉维的可持续农业生产计划（SAPP）——一个农业价值链项目的数据来说明其用途。利用现有的家庭面板数据和准实验计量经济学方法，我们发现该项目帮助小农从自给农业过渡到市场导向农业，并帮助已有的市场导向农民保持这种状态。尽管该项目没有任何专门设计用于促进非农收入的组成部分，但它仍然促进了许多农户向非农多样化生计的转变，这可能是由于当地非农经济中产生的溢出效益。所有SAPP促进的转变都导致了家庭收入的增加。最后，我们总结了一些对未来农业项目的设计、监测和评估的经验教训。

articles.title_en: Nudging consumers’ choices for niche milk: A real purchase experiment
articles.title_cn: 助推消费者对细分牛奶的选择：一项真实购买实验
articles.abstract_en: Changing behaviours causing poor health is an ongoing global health challenge that requires developing adequate food policies and strengthening their effectiveness. Policies based on nudging have become increasingly popular internationally, but the literature provides mixed evidence of their effectiveness, with an intense academic debate. This study contributes to the debate by investigating the effect of different nudging techniques (availability enhancement, visibility enhancement and healthy eating calls) via a framed field experiment involving purchases of milk types. Participants were split into different nudging treatment groups and were endowed with a cash amount to purchase any desired quantity of the different products. We modelled observed choices via the multiple discrete–continuous nested extreme value model, which has yet to receive attention for the analysis of nudging effects on food choices. Results show that only the healthy eating call nudge effectively drove participants towards healthier milk choices, while the effect of other nudges is statistically insignificant. We provide simulated demand curves conditional on nudging treatments, which measure the effect of the latter on consumers’ consumption levels of the different milk types available.
articles.abstract_cn: 改变导致健康状况不佳的行为是一个持续的全球健康挑战，需要制定适当的食品政策并加强其有效性。基于助推的政策在国际上日益流行，但文献对其有效性的证据不一，引发了激烈的学术争论。本研究通过一项涉及牛奶类型购买的框架实地实验，调查了不同助推技术（可得性增强、可见性增强和健康饮食呼吁）的效果，从而为这一争论做出贡献。参与者被分为不同的助推处理组，并被赋予一定现金以购买任意数量的不同产品。我们通过多重离散-连续嵌套极值模型对观察到的选择进行建模，该模型在分析助推对食品选择的影响方面尚未受到关注。结果表明，只有健康饮食呼吁助推有效地引导参与者选择更健康的牛奶，而其他助推的效果在统计上不显著。我们提供了基于助推处理的条件需求曲线，这些曲线衡量了助推处理对消费者可获得的不同牛奶类型消费水平的影响。

articles.title_en: Farm size and the quality and quantity of jobs—Insights from Nigeria
articles.title_cn: 农场规模与就业的数量和质量——来自尼日利亚的见解
articles.abstract_en: Debates on the role of farm size for farm productivity and economic development are longstanding in agricultural and development economics. However, the link between farm size and achieving decent work and full employment—Sustainable Development Goal 8—remains unexplored, despite many African countries facing huge unemployment challenges alongside important changes in farm sizes. This paper addresses this gap by focusing on Nigeria’s labor-intensive tomato sector and using unique primary data from a matched farm-to-worker survey. We analyze the relationship between farm size and both the quantity and quality of jobs, which has never been studied before, employing multivariate regression analysis. Additionally, we account for factors that commonly differentiate larger and smaller farms, including technology use, market arrangement, crop diversification, and the reliance on seasonal versus casual labor. Our findings reveal a trade-off: smaller farms offer more jobs per hectare, while larger farms offer better jobs (i.e., higher wages and some non-monetary benefits). We conclude that neither larger nor smaller farms fully align with all dimensions of decent work and full employment, highlighting the need for greater policy and research focus on the employment quality versus quantity dilemma.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于农场规模对农业生产力和经济发展作用的争论在农业经济学和发展经济学中长期存在。然而，农场规模与实现体面工作和充分就业——可持续发展目标8——之间的联系仍未得到探索，尽管许多非洲国家面临巨大的失业挑战，同时农场规模也在发生重要变化。本文通过关注尼日利亚劳动密集型的番茄部门，并利用来自农场与工人匹配调查的独特原始数据来填补这一空白。我们使用多元回归分析，研究了农场规模与就业数量和质量之间的关系，这是此前从未被研究过的。此外，我们考虑了通常区分大型和小型农场的因素，包括技术使用、市场安排、作物多样化以及对季节性劳动力和临时劳动力的依赖。我们的研究结果揭示了一种权衡：较小的农场每公顷提供更多就业机会，而较大的农场提供更好的就业机会（即更高的工资和一些非货币福利）。我们得出结论，无论是较大的农场还是较小的农场都不能完全符合体面工作和充分就业的所有维度，这凸显了在政策制定和研究中需要更加关注就业质量与数量之间的困境。

articles.title_en: Public acceptance of beef carbon tax earmarks
articles.title_cn: 公众对牛肉碳税专用拨款的态度
articles.abstract_en: The escalating effects of climate change make it important to find ways to offset the carbon burden. One way to do so is to reduce beef consumption, since cattle production creates large amounts of greenhouse gases, which contribute to global warming and climate change. In this study, we explore US consumers’ perceptions of alternative beef products. Specifically, we test the effects of three types of earmark information on consumers’ valuation of a beef carbon tax related to hamburger meat through two labeled discrete choice experiments. Our results show that earmark information can be effective in reducing the negative impact of an environmental tax on consumers’ willingness to pay for beef products. This study contributes to a better understanding of how consumers would bear environmental taxes for beef and alternative products.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化日益加剧的影响使得寻找抵消碳负担的方法变得重要。一种方法是减少牛肉消费，因为养牛生产产生大量温室气体，这些气体导致全球变暖和气候变化。在本研究中，我们探讨了美国消费者对替代牛肉产品的看法。具体来说，我们通过两个标记离散选择实验，测试了三种专用拨款信息对消费者对与汉堡肉相关的牛肉碳税估值的影响。我们的结果表明，专用拨款信息可以有效减少环境税对消费者购买牛肉产品意愿的负面影响。本研究有助于更好地理解消费者将如何承担牛肉及替代产品的环境税。

articles.title_en: Marriage customs and nutritional status of men and women
articles.title_cn: 婚姻习俗与男女营养状况
articles.abstract_en: Malnutrition remains a serious problem. While various nutrition policies exist, these often fail to consider cultural factors. We contribute to the literature on culture and nutrition, focusing on gendered differences in nutritional investment. Using representative panel data from Indonesia covering a period of 21 years, we analyze how ethnicity-based marriage customs are linked to the body mass index (BMI) of men and women. Patrilocal practices are positively associated with male BMI and negatively associated with female BMI, suggesting discrimination against women. Matrilocal practices are positively associated with female BMI when comparing with women in other cultural settings, but not when comparing with men. The practice of bridewealth is positively associated with male and female BMI when comparing to individuals in settings without this cultural practice. Wherever positive associations between marriage customs and BMI are observed, these are largest for those already overweight, whereas the negative association been patrilocality and female BMI is most pronounced among women who are underweight. Our findings suggest that marriage customs may reinforce nutritional inequalities. A better understanding of such links in different cultural settings is important for effective nutritional policies, especially given that different malnutrition problems coexist in many countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 营养不良仍然是一个严重的问题。尽管存在各种营养政策，但这些政策往往未能考虑文化因素。我们为关于文化与营养的文献做出贡献，重点关注营养投资中的性别差异。使用覆盖21年期间的印度尼西亚代表性面板数据，我们分析了基于种族的婚姻习俗如何与男性和女性的身体质量指数（BMI）相关联。从夫居习俗与男性BMI正相关，与女性BMI负相关，表明存在对女性的歧视。与其他文化背景下的女性相比，从妻居习俗与女性BMI正相关，但与男性相比则不然。与没有这种文化习俗的环境中的个体相比，聘礼习俗与男性和女性的BMI正相关。在观察到婚姻习俗与BMI正相关的地方，这些关联对于已经超重的人群最为显著，而从夫居与女性BMI之间的负相关在体重不足的女性中最为明显。我们的研究结果表明，婚姻习俗可能加剧营养不平等。在不同文化背景下更好地理解这种联系对于有效的营养政策至关重要，尤其是在许多国家不同营养不良问题并存的情况下。

articles.title_en: Trans-Governance and Food Systems (Tr-GaF) for food policy integration: A case study of the Australian food policy landscape
articles.title_cn: 跨治理与食品系统（Tr-GaF）用于食品政策整合：澳大利亚食品政策格局的案例研究
articles.abstract_en: Food policy integration is critical for sustainability as urban food policies become a new norm in the policy agenda. Yet, little research demonstrates how food policies are integrated with food systems and across governance to achieve urban sustainability.This paper presents the Trans-Governance and Food Systems (Tr-GaF) framework for food policy integration developed to evaluate the Australian food policy landscape. The analysis of 102 food-relevant policy documents sourced from multiple government institutions in Queensland, Western Australia, and Victoria identifies limited food policy integration in Australia, with little attention paid to food-related urban planning. Policy misalignments arise in the agrifood economy, health and well-being, and environment and ecology domains, with horizontal and vertical fragmentation across governance levels and sectors. Inadequate integration with food systems further jeopardises the efficiency of urban food supply chains and consumption activities. These three prominent issues collectively stifle urban sustainability by economically restraining food supply chain actors’ ability to innovate and compete. While environmental imbalance worsens, urbanites inevitably face barriers to maintaining health and social well-being. Tr-GaF provides an evidenced-based framework for policymakers to evaluate and integrate food policies anchored in food systems governed by collaborative multi-scalar government agencies, institutions, food industries, and civil society. In doing so, urban development can sustainably evolve economically, socially, and environmentally.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品政策整合对于可持续性至关重要，因为城市食品政策正成为政策议程中的新常态。然而，很少有研究展示食品政策如何与食品系统及跨治理层面整合以实现城市可持续性。本文提出了用于食品政策整合的跨治理与食品系统（Tr-GaF）框架，旨在评估澳大利亚的食品政策格局。对来自昆士兰州、西澳大利亚州和维多利亚州多个政府机构的102份食品相关政策文件的分析显示，澳大利亚的食品政策整合有限，对食品相关的城市规划关注甚少。政策错位出现在农业食品经济、健康与福祉以及环境与生态领域，且在治理层级和部门之间存在横向和纵向的碎片化。与食品系统的整合不足进一步危及城市食品供应链和消费活动的效率。这三个突出问题共同抑制了城市可持续性，在经济上限制了食品供应链参与者的创新和竞争能力。而环境失衡加剧，城市居民不可避免地面临维持健康和社会福祉的障碍。Tr-GaF为政策制定者提供了一个基于证据的框架，用于评估和整合以食品系统为基础的食品政策，这些政策由协作的多层级政府机构、机构、食品行业和公民社会共同治理。通过这种方式，城市发展可以在经济、社会和环境方面可持续地演进。

articles.title_en: Nutrition education effects on food and nutrition security for women living with HIV/AIDS in Uganda
articles.title_cn: 营养教育对乌干达感染艾滋病毒/艾滋病妇女的粮食和营养安全的影响
articles.abstract_en: Food and Nutrition Security (FNS) is one of the key global concerns yet in the face of HIV/AIDS, it is compromised. The significance of nutrition education targeted at women in promoting food and nutrition security cannot be overstated, considering their role in ensuring food and nutrition security for their household members. However, empirical evidence on the causal impact of nutrition education on food and nutrition status is limited to the individual level and very scanty for vulnerable groups such as HIV/AIDS-positive women. This study used a large dataset from a randomized control experiment with 3,200 women to investigate the effects of nutrition education on household behaviour and food nutrition outcomes. Results indicate that the intervention results in increasing the individual woman’s labour supply on-farm and diversifying crops grown by the household. Positive influences of nutrition education on dietary diversity are observed but were only significant at the household level. Individual women’s nutrition outcomes were strongly influenced by engagement in an income-generating activity or household’s market participation. As such, blending nutrition education interventions with initiatives that facilitate access to the needed nutritious foods such as on-farm diversification and activities that generate revenues from off the farm was recommended.
articles.abstract_cn: 粮食和营养安全是全球关注的关键问题之一，但在艾滋病毒/艾滋病面前，它受到了损害。针对妇女的营养教育在促进粮食和营养安全方面的重要性不容低估，因为她们在确保家庭成员粮食和营养安全方面发挥着作用。然而，关于营养教育对粮食和营养状况因果影响的实证证据仅限于个体层面，对于艾滋病毒/艾滋病阳性妇女等弱势群体则非常稀少。本研究使用来自一项随机对照实验的大型数据集，涉及3,200名妇女，以调查营养教育对家庭行为和粮食营养结果的影响。结果表明，干预措施增加了个体妇女在农场上的劳动供给，并使家庭种植的作物多样化。观察到营养教育对饮食多样性的积极影响，但仅在家庭层面显著。个体妇女的营养结果受到参与创收活动或家庭市场参与的强烈影响。因此，建议将营养教育干预与促进获得所需营养食品的举措相结合，如农场多样化以及从农场外产生收入的活动。

articles.title_en: Maternal employment in high-value agriculture and child nutrition: Evidence from the Ethiopian cut-flower industry
articles.title_cn: 高价值农业中的女性就业与儿童营养：来自埃塞俄比亚切花产业的证据
articles.abstract_en: In many low- and middle-income countries, agri-food supply chains are transforming rapidly. One important feature of this transformation is growth in certain high-value agricultural subsectors, such as horticulture and cut-flowers for export. Growth in high-value agriculture often creates new employment opportunities, especially for women. More employment can lead to higher rural incomes, but the broader implications for social welfare are not yet sufficiently understood. Here, we use survey data from Ethiopia to investigate the effects of women’s employment in floriculture on child nutrition, focusing on children aged 0–5 years. We develop and estimate endogenous switching regressions to account for possible endogeneity. Our results suggest that maternal employment in floriculture negatively affects child height-for-age and weight-for-age z-scores (HAZ and WAZ). Exploration of the underlying mechanisms reveals that floriculture employment may influence time allocation, dietary quality, income, and female financial autonomy. Maternal employment is negatively associated with time spent on childcare and consumption of animal-sourced foods.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入和中等收入国家，农业食品供应链正在快速转型。这一转型的一个重要特征是某些高价值农业子部门（如园艺和出口切花）的增长。高价值农业的增长往往创造新的就业机会，尤其是对女性而言。更多就业可以带来更高的农村收入，但其对社会福利的更广泛影响尚未得到充分理解。在此，我们利用埃塞俄比亚的调查数据，研究花卉产业中女性就业对儿童营养的影响，重点关注0-5岁儿童。我们开发并估计了内生转换回归模型以处理潜在的内生性问题。我们的结果表明，花卉产业中的母亲就业对儿童年龄别身高和年龄别体重z分数（HAZ和WAZ）有负面影响。对潜在机制的探索显示，花卉产业就业可能影响时间分配、饮食质量、收入和女性财务自主权。母亲就业与用于儿童照护的时间和动物源性食品消费呈负相关。
